sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Bamboo Jungle, Birch Forest, Cherry Grove, Dark Forest, Forest, Grove, Jungle, and Old Growth Birch Forest and 6 more biomes.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Special bug moves and grass moves are 1.5× stronger.
Air Cutter, Air Slash, Breaking Swipe, Cut, Fury Cutter, Psycho Cut, and Slash also count as Grass for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Air Cutter, Air Slash, Attack Order, Branch Poke, Breaking Swipe, Electroweb, Fury Cutter, Grav Apple, Psycho Cut, and Slash: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Bug-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Muddy Water and Surf change the field into Swamp once their uses add up to 3 (Muddy Water 2 and Surf 1).

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Jungle Beat: 1.5× power for sound-based moves.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Sap Sipper restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: is shielded as by Spiky Shield.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
